import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] edge = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] buf = new char[20][20];
    static int n, m, vn, from[] = new int[7000], flow[] = new int[7000], tox[][] = new int[10][10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7000; i++) {
            edge[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int aug(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int result = 0;
        for (int aug = 1; aug > 0; ) {
            Arrays.fill(from, -1);
            from[s] = s;
            flow[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
            bfs.offer(s);
            while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                int x = bfs.poll();
                if (x == t) {
                    for (int x2 = x; x2 != s; x2 = from[x2]) {
                        int f = flow[t];
                        int u = from[x2];
                        edge[u].put(x2, edge[u].getOrDefault(x2, 0) - f);
                        edge[x2].put(u, edge[x2].getOrDefault(u, 0) + f);
                        x = u;
                    }
                    result += flow[t];
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> e : edge[x].entrySet()) {
                    int y = e.getKey();
                    int capEdge = e.getValue();
                    if (capEdge >= cap && from[y] == -1) {
                        from[y] = x;
                        flow[y] = Math.min(capEdge, flow[x]);
                        bfs.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (from[t] == -1) break;
            aug = 0; // Exit condition for outer loop
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int enc(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * n + t * n * n + 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            buf[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    edge[0].put(enc(i, j, 0), buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            buf[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        Queue<int[]> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (buf[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tox[i][j] = 0;
                    bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                } else {
                    tox[i][j] = m + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfsQueue.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            int t = tox[x][y];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && buf[nx][ny] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[nx][ny]) {
                    tox[nx][ny] = t + 1;
                    bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        vn = enc(n - 1, n - 1, m) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < m; t++) {
                    if (t < m) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q];
                            int y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < tox[x][y] + (buf[x][y] > '0' && buf[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0) && t < tox[i][j]) {
                                edge[enc(i, j, t)].put(enc(x, y, t + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                            edge[enc(i, j, t)].put(enc(i, j, m), buf[i][j] - '0');
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    edge[enc(i, j, m)].put(1, buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            res += aug(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
